description: Unit test class for EmployeeSupervisorAPI, focusing on testing API endpoints related to employee supervision via PHPUnit. Contains multiple test methods that mock dependencies, validate rules, and check CRUD operations for employee supervision reports.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSupervisorAPI endpoints, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Validates retrieval of a single employee supervisor record, mocking DAO and Service dependencies, and verifying normalization output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the 'getOne' API endpoint, ensuring proper access permissions based on user roles.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint with user access permissions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all supervisor records for a given employee, including counting and list fetching, with proper normalization.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies creation of a new supervisor-reporting method link, mocking DAO save, and validating output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for creating a supervisor link, asserting correct validation schema.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing supervisor record, including fetching, validating, and changing reporting method.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates access and input validation rules for updating supervisor info.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of supervisor records, ensuring the DAO delete method is invoked and handling not found exceptions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates delete input rules and user access permissions.
